draw: 2026 controlled hunt drawings (deer and elk): first drawing (June) and second drawing (leftover permits, August)
choice_basis: 1st-choice applicants and 1st-choice permits drawn in the FIRST drawing. res/nr row = [null, ResApp, ResPermit] / [null, NonResApp, NonResPermit]; verified ResApp+NonResApp == ApplChoice1 and ResPermit+NonResPermit == SuccChoice1 for every hunt. q.all = PermitAvailable (total permits in the first drawing; no res/nr quota published). Permits that went to 2nd-choice applicants are in "choice2" {applicants: ApplChoice2, drawn: SuccChoice2}. "second" = the second (leftover) drawing: applicants/drawn = 1st-choice applicants/permits, permits = leftover permits available, with res/nr split [null, applicants, drawn].

sources.label: IDFG odds API (biggame=1 deer / 2 elk, yr=2026, draw=1|2)

about: Counts are first-choice applicants and permits drawn in the first controlled hunt drawing. Idaho has no points, so everyone in a pool has the same odds.
